# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.12.0

**Watch the best runs on every leaderboard.** This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

- **Online replays.** **Watch replays** has a new **Online** tab with the top 50 of every leaderboard, Master boards included. A run with a play mark has a replay: press **A** (Enter) and it downloads and plays.
- **The run just above you.** The Online tab marks your row and the one just above it, and opens with the cursor there when it can be watched. See exactly how the next player beat you.
- **Easy to get around.** The board sits in the middle with its neighbours either side. **LB / RB** (1 / 3), or left and right, step through the boards, and each Master board sits beside its base mode, so Master Deadline is one press from Deadline. **B** (Esc) goes back to your own replays.
- **Watch Replay on the game's own leaderboard screen.** On a row with a replay, **View Gamer Card** becomes **Watch Replay**.
- **Share your top runs.** When a run sets your best and makes a board's top 50, its replay is shared too, and the game says so the first time. Bests you already have are shared when this PC still has their replay. Turn it off with **Share my top runs as replays** in the launcher's Online leaderboards settings. Only your own best's replay is ever kept, only while it is in the top 50, and runs with cheats on are never sent.

Replays can only be shared from v0.12.0 or newer. Everything from v0.11.0 is still here: Master Deadline and Master Evolved, custom modes, the benchmark and the Fast render path.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.12.0-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
